capabilities: Create book and annotations notes from selected Markdown templates
Sync annotation text, comments, colors, pages and deep links from Zotero
Create and update one atomic note per annotation
Restore paragraph and list boundaries from the local PDF
Preserve manually renamed atomic notes and user content outside managed blocks
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.12.7 or newer; synchronization is manual only, and no Zotero API key or cloud account is needed. Installation is by copying release files into the plugins folder; a Russian-language description mirrors the English documentation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull PDF highlights and annotations out of a Zotero library into structured, linked notes.

relations.evidence: synchronizing PDF annotations from a locally running Zotero installation

requires.name: Zotero Desktop with local API enabled

summary: Creates linked book notes and one atomic note per annotation from user templates, and manually syncs PDF annotations from a locally running Zotero.
